name: Lia
source:
An aristocratic girl brimming with curiosity who is living without any inconveniences.
She feels attracted to the protagonist when she sees him in low spirits in front of the castle gate and invites him to work in her mansion.
But without forgetting their difference of social status, she approaches him as if playing around.
